title: Change of variables for Hausdorff integrals under the blow-up map η_{x,r} (fact F1)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), r > 0, A ⊆ ℝ^N an arbitrary set and g : ℝ^N → ℝ an arbitrary function. Let η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) (blowUpMap x r) and Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^N. Then ∫_{η_{x,r}(A)} g dHⁿ = (rⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_A g(η_{x,r}(z)) dHⁿ(z). Both sides are Bochner integrals for the restricted measures Hⁿ⌞η_{x,r}(A) and Hⁿ⌞A, with value 0 for non-integrable integrands, so the identity holds whether or not g is integrable.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (x : Rn N) (r : ℝ) (A : Set (Rn N)) (g : Rn N → ℝ), 0 < r → ∫ y in blowUpMap x r '' A, g y ∂μHE[n] = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in A, g (blowUpMap x r z) ∂μHE[n]
